title.english: "要……了" Indicating the State of an Action

explanation.hanzi: 用"快要/快/就要/要……了"表示某事将要发生。如果句子中有时间状语,只能用"就要……了"。
explanation.english: "快要 / 快 / 就要 / 要 … 了" means something is about to happen. If the sentence contains a time adverbial, only "就要 … 了" can be used.

explanation.hanzi: "都……了"可以表示"已经"的意思,通常含有强调或不满的语气。
explanation.english: "都……了" expresses "already", usually with an emphatic or complaining tone.

examples.pinyin: Dōu bā diǎn le, kuài diǎnr qǐ chuáng ba.

examples.hanzi: 你都十岁了,可以自己洗衣服了。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ dōu shí suì le, kěyǐ zìjǐ xǐ yīfu le.
examples.english: You're already ten — you can wash your own clothes.

examples.pinyin: Dōu děng tā bàn ge xiǎoshí le.
examples.english: We've already waited for her half an hour.

title.english: The Chinese New Year — Spring Festival

culture.body:
Spring Festival (春节, Chūn Jié), the Chinese New Year, is the most important traditional festival in China. It's a happy, merry day when family members reunite. Every year people away from home travel back to celebrate with their families.

Together they paste antithetical couplets (对联), set off firecrackers (放鞭炮), eat dumplings (吃饺子), and watch the Spring Festival Gala (春节联欢晚会). Kids especially love the festival because they get "lucky money" (压岁钱) from their elders.

The bustling, festive atmosphere fills every home, every street and every lane. In some places there are lion dances (舞狮子), dragon-lantern shows (耍龙灯), and temple fairs (逛庙会).
